jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: About Wayflyer Businesses come to Wayflyer to get the capital they need to grow. When they apply, connect their data or upload documents, every screen, word and transition either builds their trust or loses it. We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer with exceptional craft, strong product instincts and a builder mentality to shape how they access and manage capital. You will take financial workflows and information-rich experiences from first idea to shipped product, and make them feel intuitive and trustworthy. As part of our fully remote team of 15 designers across Product, Brand, Motion, and Design. Systems, you’ll collaborate across disciplines, share a common design system, and challenge each other’s work through open critiques, always pushing the quality of our craft forward. How we think about craft Craft is for the customer. Design should improve experiences, not just appearances. Execution matters. From pixels to micro-interactions, nothing should feel accidental. Trust is built through details . Especially when making decisions about their money. Quality is a choice we make every day. It is not a final polish step or a handoff. Speed and quality go together. We ship early, learn from real use and keep improving. You can't write quality into a spec. It comes from people who care and who build. Who Thrives Here You don't wait for perfect requirements. You define the problem first. You balance customer needs, business goals and technical limits. You believe simplifying is one of the hardest and most valuable design skills. You care deeply about craft and know that details matter. You know that trust in financial products is built through hundreds of small interactions. You push back when it matters, for the customer and for quality. You use AI to explore, prototype and improve your work. You thrive in a fast-moving team. What You'll Actually Do Own complex financial problems from discovery to delivery, and turn dense data into clear, scalable experiences.

jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. You'll lead five designers today, and you'll be the reason that team, and what it produces, keeps compounding. Design at TRM doesn't wait for a brief. Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to drive architectural decisions and platform-wide design standards. Champion a culture of design excellence by mentoring senior designers and fostering high-quality craft across the organisation. Identify and tackle systemic design opportunities that improve performance, accessibility, and user satisfaction at scale.

jobs.title: Partnerships Manager, AI & Frontier Labs
jobs.description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role As AI designs more of biology, the bottleneck moves to experiments: running them fast, at scale and with data people can trust. Frontier AI labs and biotechs work with Adaptyv to close that loop, and many of these relationships grow into long-term partnerships. You run these partnerships day to day, from the first project through delivery and renewal, and you make sure each partner gets more value from Adaptyv over time. What You'll Do Run partner projects. You scope experiments and benchmarks with partner scientists and AI researchers, and you keep projects on track with our lab and engineering teams. Grow each partnership. You find the next project, the larger campaign or the new team inside the same partner, and you help shape the terms. Bring the partner’s voice back.

Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.
